DevopsPipeline.name: DevopsPipeline
DevopsPipeline.description: Represents a release pipeline in DevOps Center, which is the ordered path work items follow from development to production. Related DevopsPipelineStage records store the pipeline stages.

Description.description: A brief text that explains the purpose of the pipeline or the team it supports.

IsActive.description: Indicates whether the pipeline is active. When true, you can promote work items on this pipeline.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: The unique name of the DevOps pipeline.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the pipeline.

PackageDirectories.description: The file path to the package directories defined in the sfdx-project.json file.

SourceCodeRepositoryId.description: Identifies the source control repository associated with this pipeline.
